meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能读取、转换、修剪、重根系统发育树,计算树间距离(如 RF),检测基因树中的重复/分化事件,识别直系同源/旁系同源,整合 NCBI 分类,并输出 PDF/SVG/PNG 图表。
howto.when: 当用户提供树文件并要求读取/编辑、比较、进化事件分析、分类注释或可视化时触发;不要用它从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 帮我读取 tree.nw,修剪到人、鼠、鸡,再按中点重新根。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can read/convert/edit trees, compare via Robinson-Foulds, detect gene-tree duplication/speciation and orthology, integrate NCBI taxonomy, and render PDF/SVG/PNG figures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a tree file and asks for reading/editing, comparison, evolutionary event analysis, taxonomy annotation, or visualization. Not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw, prune to human, mouse, and chicken, then reroot at midpoint.
Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw using Robinson-Foulds distance.
say_en.note: Outputs RF distance and different partitions.

say_en.text: Annotate species_tree.nw leaves with NCBI taxonomy and output a PDF.
say_en.note: Generates a tree figure with taxonomy.
